$comment: Changes reach main and dev only through a squash-merged PR whose 'pr-check / Work PR' and 'pr-check / Release PR' checks passed (each is skipped, so passed, for the other kind of PR). DISABLED by default: release.yml pushes the release commit to main and force-points dev with GITHUB_TOKEN, so the GitHub Actions app (Integration 15368) must be able to bypass it. Enable it per repo with .github/rulesets/require-pull-request.json containing {"enforcement": "active"}, run one release, and confirm it went through. Reference: docs/REPO_RULES.md.
name: ci: require pull request
